claim_one_line: CELL 1: J^{2T} IS THE CHARGE FIELD -- the fixed Jordan subalgebra of the principal 2T in F4 = Aut(J) is K = Q[x]/(x^3-12x-5), FIELD discriminant exactly 6237 = 3^4*7*11, totally real, Galois S3, verified three independent ways (root test; disc f = 6237*61931520^2 with the square factored out and no extension machinery; the reduced model L^3-273L+1372 with disc 6237*70^2). Against the two-sided sealed criterion: it is a cubic FIELD so there are no primitive idempotents over Q and NO RATIONAL rank-1 VEV, but it is TOTALLY REAL so over R it splits into three, and cell 1 exhibits all three explicitly -- they sum to the identity exactly, a complete orthogonal frame, and their coordinates are Galois-conjugate with the same square-free disc part 77. Every E6/F4 invariant of a single idempotent (tr 1, sigma_2 -1/3, det 0) is IDENTICAL across the three, and all symmetric functions are rational, so THE CHOICE OF REAL EMBEDDING IS INVISIBLE TO EVERYTHING GALOIS-INVARIANT -- a gauge, not a parameter, costing zero invariant information. Consequence for any future dynamical import: it can only matter if it is NOT Galois-equivariant. CELL 2 IS WITHDRAWN the same day it was written -- three errors, none caught by its own gates: the reductive part was inferred from an ambiguous dimension (44 fits both so(8)+16 and su(5)+20); the claim that orthogonality is a degenerate position is FALSE, since the control over all 351 weight-vector pairs gives spectrum {44:135, 49:216} so 44 is GENERIC and the object's pair is in the generic orbit; and the pairing computed was two vectors of the SAME 27, whereas the standard route is 27 (+) 27-bar, which reproduces correctly at minimum dim 45 with Killing rank 24 = su(5). A repair attempt added a fourth error, reusing the 27's coordinates on the bar side to produce rank-3 vectors (stabiliser 52, not 61). WHAT SURVIVES: weight vectors of the minuscule 27 are rank 1 (stab 61); the three invariant idempotents are rank 1; two rank-1 elements of the same 27 give generic stabiliser 44 with reductive part 28; 27 (+) 27-bar gives 45 with reductive part 24 = su(5). OPEN AND NOT COMPUTED: the 27-bar's own cubic form, its own 2T-invariant idempotents, and the joint stabiliser of a 27-idempotent with a 27-bar-idempotent -- only that decides whether the object reaches su(5). CELL 1 IS UNAFFECTED and has no dependency on cell 2.
